name: progress
title: Progress
description: Solid bar in the accent colour with a soft glowing head that rides the fill (or sweeps when indeterminate, or carries animated stripes), an SVG ring with a glowing arc tip whose percentage counts up and morphs into a drawn check, and segments that pop as they fill while the current step pulses. Reaching max plays a short success flash.
props: Horizontal bar, circular ring, or a row of segments.
0 → max (completed steps for steps). Omit for indeterminate.
Comet sweep on the bar, spinning arc on the ring.
Segment count for the steps variant.
Fill colour (solid); the track, glow and pulse are tints of it.
Caption above the bar or under the ring.
Show the percentage (a drawn check once complete).
At max, flash the fill and turn the value into a drawn check.
Animated diagonal stripes on the linear fill for processing states.
Style for the root view of the bar, ring or step row.
